name: How does permit and inspection coordination work from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How does permit and inspection coordination work from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with application prep, then submission, then plan review, then permit issuance, and finally inspection scheduling. In Denver, you can search by address or permit number in e-permits, but inspections can only be scheduled after the permit is issued.
acceptedAnswer.description: It typically follows four steps: prepare the permit package, submit it, respond to review comments, and schedule inspections after issuance. Denver’s e-permits system lets you track status and inspection results in one place.
